Cabibbo_boundary: Use the positive CKM overlap at the upper neutral cluster in the same one-loop run. Normalize a as one accessible state; each raw b path carries one copy of this positive charged spurion. The alignments and the choices of normalization and transfer are candidate-model assumptions.
terminal_boundary: Leading common positive susceptibility of two aligned terminal ports, with couplings m and q from 1689 in the same sterile unit. Alternative: independent equal terminal coefficients. A common overall terminal scale is determined by the solar gap.
